plotEn:
Two years after the events of the previous film, Becky, now eighteen, has been recruited by the CIA, but has been suspended multiple times thanks to her anger issues. After going rogue again on her third mission, CIA Director Baker discusses Becky’s position with Agent Montana and Agent Rigby, Becky’s love interest. Director Baker reprimands Becky about how she used an intel computer as a meat mallet and bashed the targets head in with it. 
Now stuck on probation at her apartment in New York, Becky laments on how she can never return to a normal life while she looks at videos of her dog Diego, having given him away to a new family. Some time later, Becky gets recruited for a rescue mission by Director Baker, who informs Becky that Neo-Nazi General Wilhelm Reuss is responsible for Dominic Lewis’s jailbreak all those years ago. Director Baker also reveals how the valknut key Dominic was looking for under Becky’s lake house was hidden there by Reuss’s great-grandfather several years ago, thus revealing the key actually has coordinates to The Wolf’s Lair in Poland and that the key unlocks a hidden chamber underneath the lair.
Becky agrees to go undercover but is soon after caught by Reuss. Becky finds out that he has been killing guests and draining their blood, hence why he needed the key in the first place; the key unlocks a cryo-chamber holding a clone of Hitler in an attempt to create a Fourth Reich.
